name: drivemart
description: DriveMart: jogo web no estilo Driver (PS1) com compra e personalização de prédios via Pix.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n emu,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w @drivemart/web"
scripts.emulators: node scripts/ensure-secrets.mjs && npm run build -w @drivemart/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-drivemart --import .emulator-data --export-on-exit .emulator-data
scripts.build: npm run build -w @drivemart/web && npm run build -w @drivemart/functions
scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/ensure-secrets.mjs && npm run build -w @drivemart/functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-drivemart --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
